title: open-mic — the mic stays on; every finished sentence is transcribed and routed as it ends

set.request: Open-mic mode in Dictate (mic stays on, sentences commit continuously, nothing auto-fills the box); fast-assistant route field on cards; master-assistant listens and disputes/refines; mixed-clock fix; selection-aware routing with judgment; page-mention links.
set.now: reassigned by the mastermind: items 9-12 of the open-mic addenda, working directly in the main tree (worktree torn down)
steps: read common.md + requirements.md + Dictate.js + Servex agents
1: open-mic mode in Dictate (mode:"open", no box writes, settled caption stream)
2: route field on assistant.md + card rendering in inbox/talk
also: mixed clocks - let Servex stamp at, or local-offset format
5: selection-aware routing with judgment + re-route line
6: mention links via directory.json in refined text + card title

set.outcome: Items 9-12 landed directly in the main tree, proven on the owner's own :8123. The mic now looks like a fact, not a flicker: solid orange ring when listening, everywhere Dictate mounts, with a separate small bar for the sound level. AI 2's top composer is typed-only; the mic lives on each card's own page, with a remembered 'auto-transcribe' checkbox beside + New card (default on). Archived cards are never deleted - an 'archived (n)' word at the rail's foot brings them back, greyed, and every card page has a small 'clear' control that sends one there. A link the fast assistant wraps in a page mention now actually renders as a link in AI 2, not just on the talk page. One item, no-mid-sentence-breaks (11), was attempted, found to introduce a real merging regression under test, and reverted rather than shipped - logged as an honest follow-up with the specific reason it needs a sturdier fix.
